text:
maya: Heads-up: onboarding sample app spiking soft 429s during pagination when tokens rotate mid-run. Repro in local CI.

leo: Any logs?

maya: small snippet:
INFO page=12 inflight=5 status=401
INFO token refresh start
INFO token refresh done
INFO retry page=12 inflight=6 duplicate request -> upstream 429

cecil: Sounds like the inflight permit wasn't released before the retry path re-acquired. We saw this pattern before.

kevin: Short fix: auth wrapper call release() before refresh then reacquire after. Long-term: switch to lease-style acquires so retries reuse the original lease id.

cecil: Lease sketch: `const lease = await window.acquireLease(); try { await sendWithAuth(req, {leaseId: lease.id}); } finally { window.releaseLease(lease.id); }` sendWithAuth must reuse leaseId on retries. Keeps accounting stable.

leo: Can someone add a tiny integration test in sampleapp that forces mid-batch 401s? I'll own the SDK change once test is green.

maya: I'll push a flaky auth test and attach traces.

devex-bot: Created ticket RDW-4120: "sampleapp: inflight overshoot during auth-retry" and linked branch r/patch/lease-window. Assign: kevin (impl), maya (test).
